# Raj Krishna Silwal

> Official portfolio of Raj Krishna Silwal, a Computer Science graduate and software developer from Nepal, with interests in Data Science, Machine Learning, Python, backend development, and web application development.

## About

Raj Krishna Silwal is a Computer Science graduate from Nepal and a software developer interested in Data Science, Machine Learning, Python, Django, backend development, and practical software applications.

He has experience working with Python, Django, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, and database-driven web applications.
